values.note: Reservations at least 5 days ahead; the calendar hides those 5 days, so call the office. Drive-in welcome but reservations take priority. The October festival fills it. Holiday minimum: Memorial Day, Labor Day, and Fourth of July if it falls on a Friday or Monday.

booking.source: https://www.vbcountyconservation.com/morris-campgrounds.html ('Holiday weekends... requires 3 nights to reserve'; 'Sites can be obtained by drive in or online reservations... usually open sites to drive in with the exception of the October festival') + mycountyparks site 01 ('Reservations must be made at least 5 days in advance'), read 2026-11-02

values.note: Van Buren County: $17 a night in 2026, rising to $20 in 2027. Read 2026-11-02.

fees.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Van-Buren/Park/Morris-Park/Facility/Morris-Campground-site-01 ('Camping rates are $17/night in 2026 but will be increasing to $20/night in 2027'), read 2026-11-02

note: Van Buren County Conservation Board campground in a shady spot at the back of historic Morris Memorial Park, past the buildings. From November through April there is no water and no snow removal. Stocked pond on-site but campsites are set back in the woods, not on the water. --Claude
summary: County pages confirm 20/30/50A, showers, dump, year-round, $17 in 2026 ($20 in 2027), 3-night holiday minimum now in min_stay. Water hookup true -> false (hydrants to fill a tank), count 15 -> 14. Not waterfront holds.
flags: WATERFRONT holds at not waterfront. The only water at the camp is the Morris pond, about 70 x 70 m on imagery (~1.3 acres), under the 5-acre pond floor. The stored evidence's 'large lake east' isn't there on current imagery: east of the park is a field dark under cloud shadow.

SITE COUNT: 15 -> 14. County says the loop runs site 1 to site 14; the online listing shows 13 of them (no 05). The county also prices '$12/night primitive', with no count, so the old 15 may have come from there.
mycountyparks heads each site '$20 /Night' already, while its text and the Fees block say $17 in 2026; the fee record keeps $17 with the 2027 rise in its note.
